description: Install dependencies and verify baseline build is green before making changes.
steps: Run `pnpm install` in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web/ to install dependencies
Run `pnpm typecheck` in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web/ to verify TypeScript compiles
Run `pnpm lint` in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web/ to verify no lint errors
Run `pnpm build` in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web/ to verify production build succeeds
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build produces a successful build output
verification: Run `pnpm install && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build` in web/ directory
findings: All baseline checks pass cleanly. pnpm install added 735 packages. TypeScript typecheck (react-router typegen + tsc --noEmit) passes. ESLint passes with no errors. Production build (client SSR + server SSR) succeeds in ~4.4s total. pnpm version is 10.30.2 (update available to 11.2.2 but not required). Build uses Vite 8.0.12 with react-router plugin.
